summary: Create a shallow selected-range copy while preserving holes.

target.notes: Coerce/clamp start and end, preserve absent indexed properties as holes in the result, and create an intrinsic Array under the stated species requirement.

caveats: GetRange/LINQ materialization does not preserve sparse holes.
Custom Symbol.species is excluded and requires runtime fallback.

tests.name: holes preserved
tests.input: const a=[,1]; const b=a.slice(0,1); console.log(b.length,0 in b,b[0]);
